props.description: What kind of failure it is: `unauthenticated`, `forbidden`, `not-found` or `unexpected`. Defaults to `unexpected`.
props.name: kind

props.description:
The thrown value, as caught. An `Error` or a string shows its message outside production; its stack is shown
outside production only.
props.name: error

props.description:
Whether the error's message is shown. It defaults to true outside production and false in production, because a
server or driver message (a database or gateway error) is an internal the user must not read. An app whose error
carries text written for the user (a typed refusal's message) sets it to true.
props.name: isMessageShown

props.description: A button that tries again: its label in the app's language and what it runs. Left out, there is no button.
props.name: retry
props.type: { readonly label: string; readonly onPress: () => void; }

props.description: What is the matter, in a few words. Required: it is the heading a screen reader jumps to.
props.name: title

props.description: One or two sentences: why it is so, and what to do next.
props.name: description

props.description: An icon in place of the reason's or kind's own, or `false` for none.
props.name: icon

props.description: Buttons or links for the reader's next step, drawn under the description in a wrapping row.
props.name: actions

props.description: The title's place in the document outline, 1 to 6, so the page keeps one outline wherever this sits.
props.name: headingLevel

props.description: Used to reference react managed views from native code.
props.name: id

props.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.
props.name: testID
